DIMENSIONS FOR 
OPTIONAL RECESS ON MORSE TAPER SHANKS 

FOR TOOLS 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions for an optional recess on morse taper shanks for tools according to 
IS : 1715-1973 'Dimensions for setf-holding tapers ( first revision ) '. 

1.1 This recess can be provided by the manufacturer for the purpose of marking, if marking is not 
possible at any other place on the tool.

Note — Other dimensions according to IS 1715-1973. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Morse taper shank tools, such as drills, reamers, etc, especially having negligible neck between 
the shank and cutting portion, cannot be marked easily. Tool manufacturers, therefore, have to use a 
relief for marking purpose as specified in this standard. Such a problem does not exist, when a morse 
taper shank is used on items other than tools. Therefore, instead of amending IS : 1715-1973 to include 
the relief dimensions, it was decided by Small Tools Sectional Committee, EDC 45 to issue a separate 
standard covering the dimensions for tools only. 

This standard has been prepared in accordance with the current practices prevalent in the tool 
industry.
